releases.name: v0.3.0 - three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates
releases.notes:
v0.3.0 — three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy, three hard gates

This release turns the single research skill into a small family: the core deep
research skill plus two optional capability skills it hands work off to, with a
cleaner deliverable and a stricter delivery gate. It is the full diff from
v0.2.0.

## Three cooperating skills

- **`meld-deepresearch`** — the core research / evidence / citation loop. Still
 Python-standard-library only.
- **`meld-da`** — an Excel / spreadsheet data-analysis workflow (reading,
 cleaning, filtering, aggregation, statistics, charts, export), adapted from
 SenseNova-Skills' `sn-da-excel-workflow` (MIT) and reworked for portable use.
 Its Python packages are optional; without them it degrades to the built-in
 zero-dependency reader.
- **`meld-search-academic`** — academic search, paper full-text and section
 reading, and citation-tree tracing across arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google
 Scholar, PubMed, Crossref, OpenAlex, SSRN, Wikipedia and more, adapted from
 `sn-search-academic` (MIT). Its browser-crawler tier is optional and degrades
 to the official APIs and then to generic search.

Cross-skill hand-offs are documented in `references/protocol.md` section 2a:
local table files plus analysis route to `meld-da`; academic, scientific or
historical subjects route the scholarly layer through `meld-search-academic`.

en.headline: 3 own commits, 6 bot commits, 1 issue opened, v0.3.0 released
en.summary: On 2026-10-06, `sogeisetsu` made **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, plus 6 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The own commits covered a release chore for `v0.3.1`, docs updates adding high-intent search terms to skill descriptions, and a CI fix making the academic degrade test dependency-aware with a draw gate at 3. No pull requests or reviews were filed. One issue was opened: `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` issue `#11`, titled "[Feature]: 让 harness 可扩展（支持 OpenCode/Pi 等），并考虑以 MCP 形式对外暴露". In `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` issue `#458` ("OpenCode v2 integration: fix skills install path + add mcp target"), `goworm` commented on the skills install path fix and then closed the issue. The `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` `v0.3.0` release was published, turning the single research skill into a family of three cooperating skills with a cleaner deliverable and stricter delivery gate.

zh.headline: 3 次本人提交，6 次机器人提交，新开 1 个 issue，发布 v0.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-06，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 中完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 6 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中自动提交。本人提交涵盖 `v0.3.1` 的发布整理、为技能描述补充高意图搜索词的文档更新，以及让学术降级测试依赖感知并在 3 处设置平局门槛的 CI 修复。当天没有提交 PR 或代码评审。新开 1 个 issue：`OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch` 的 `#11`，标题为"[Feature]: 让 harness 可扩展（支持 OpenCode/Pi 等），并考虑以 MCP 形式对外暴露"。在 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` 的 issue `#458`（"OpenCode v2 integration: fix skills install path + add mcp target"）中，`goworm` 就技能安装路径修复进行了评论，随后关闭了该 issue。`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 发布了 `v0.3.0`，将单一研究技能扩展为三个协作技能，并带来更清晰的交付物与更严格的交付门槛。

releaseNotes.summary: v0.3.0 将单一研究技能扩展为一个小家族：核心 `meld-deepresearch` 技能加上两个可选的能力技能，并带来更清晰的交付物与更严格的交付门槛。这是相对 v0.2.0 的完整差异。
